note: Attacker-controlled pcap file is opened by libpcap; the global header's network/linktype field (set to 2 in the PoC) is parsed without any validation against known link types.
The file-controlled datalink integer (2) is cast to pcpp::LinkLayerType with no validation, producing an enum value that is not one of the declared enumerators (invalid enum value).
A valid packet record in the PoC makes pcap_next return non-NULL so execution proceeds past the end-of-file check toward the enum use.

The invalid LinkLayerType enum value stored in m_PcapLinkLayerType is loaded and passed to RawPacket::setRawData; the sanitizer flags the load of the invalid enum value here (and the value later drives packet parsing).
